display.purpose: All headings (h1-h6 globally), hero copy, section titles.

script.purpose: Rare handwritten accent note; never body or headline copy.

body.purpose: All functional and paragraph copy, labels, nav, buttons.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for buttons and shallow cards.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Hover lift for interactive cards and buttons.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback on all buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Coral-filled pill button, the default high-emphasis CTA on marketing surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(4,77%,55%); color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(4,77%,45%); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(4,77%,55%); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Coral-bordered secondary CTA; fills solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: hsl(4,77%,55%); border: 2px solid hsl(4,77%,55%); padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(4,77%,55%); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Catalog/product card: soft shadow at rest, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 300ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: hsl(40,33%,97%); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 12px 16px 0; color: hsl(0,0%,13%); } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; color: hsl(4,77%,55%); font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 16px 16px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field; coral focus ring matches button focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid hsl(0,0%,90%); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; background: #fff; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(4,77%,55%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(4,77%,55%,0.2); }

narrative.overview: RentBasket furnishes a home you might not stay in forever, and the design has to earn that trust in one sitting: warm enough to feel like a real home outfitter (Article.com, West Elm), restrained enough to feel like a well-run product (Linear, Vercel), never like a discount big-box retailer or a templated SaaS trial page. The coral-to-gold warmth carries the comfort/care half of the brand; the restraint (flat surfaces, soft ambient shadows, generous whitespace) carries the conserve half. A turtle mascot recurs across marketing sections as the one deliberately playful, unhurried note in an otherwise clean system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm coral/gold brand gradient reserved for hero moments and primary CTAs
Soft, ambient shadow language — never hard drop shadows
Serif display (Playfair Display) paired with humanist sans (Inter)
Fully pill-shaped buttons as the signature interactive shape on marketing surfaces
HSL CSS custom properties as the single source of truth for color

rules.name: The Reserved Gradient Rule
rules.body: The coral-to-gold gradients are hero-and-CTA-only. Gradient text is never used for emphasis; treat existing instances as legacy risk, not a pattern to extend.

rules.name: The One-Voice Italic Rule
rules.body: The italic coral headline-accent treatment is the single reserved way to emphasize one word inside a serif headline — not a general-purpose emphasis tool.

rules.name: The Hover-Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive surfaces start at soft/card shadow at rest and transition to elevated on hover, never the reverse.

dos: Do keep every color reference flowing through the HSL custom properties in src/index.css
Do use the pill-shaped brand button classes for marketing-surface CTAs
Do pair Playfair Display headlines with Inter body copy consistently
Do verify body-text contrast against cream backgrounds specifically, not just white
Do feature the turtle mascot deliberately in hero, empty-state, and success moments
Do write button labels, empty states, and error copy in specific, considered language
donts: Don't use background-clip gradient text for emphasis
Don't add a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section, or numbered section markers where content isn't a genuine sequence
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe
Don't default new marketing CTAs to the shadcn Button primitive's rounded-md shape
Don't use hard, high-contrast drop shadows anywhere
Don't let hero or hierarchy-critical headline copy overflow at tablet widths
